description_expanded: This beautiful new 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath Alys Beach vacation rental fronts North Charles Street which leads directly to the beach. The home is steps away from the emerging Town Center, the Caliza pool complex and Raw and Juicy restaurant. The first floor surrounds a shaded loggia and a courtyard with a private pool. There is ample outdoor seating and a built-in grill. Indoor space includes an open floor plan blending kitchen, dining and living room. A first floor Guest Primary suite overlooks the private courtyard with a vaulted beamed ceiling and bathroom with a double sink vanity. The second floor includes three bedrooms and an additional sitting area with a large television. The spacious primary bedroom features a king-sized bed, separate walk-in shower and soaking tub as well as split double vanity. The second and third bedrooms on this level contain a king-sized bed and two twin beds and each feature access to private baths. Guests staying in Alys Beach vacation rental properties enjoy personalized concierge services, exclusive access to the Caliza Pool and Restaurant, ZUMA Wellness Center and Café, advance access to purchase tickets to many of our signature events, a stunning new racquet sports venue, and private beach access. Each property includes Wifi, cable TV, YOLO coffee, kitchen supplies and 24-hour security included with the Resort Fee. An interactive vacation rental guest portal will be available to you and your guests to further help you plan your best vacation experience at Alys Beach. Beach chair set ups, beach food and beverage delivery, bicycle rentals, water sports equipment, private signature experiences and family portrait photography sessions (through our Preferred Photographer program) are also available at additional costs – our concierge will be happy to make recommendations.
